code: MSAN report names QImage::pixel -> XCFImageFormat::mergeIndexedAToRGB -> XCFImageFormat::mergeLayerIntoImage
note: The vulnerable path is in XCF decoding, specifically indexed-alpha layer merging.
Attacker-controlled bytes are fed directly into the XCF image handler.
The parser interprets the input as an XCF file and begins building an in-memory image/layer model.
For indexed-alpha images, the code allocates separate indexed image tiles and alpha tiles, then later merges them.
Tile bytes are decompressed from attacker-controlled RLE data and copied into the per-tile images.

code: if (copy == copyRGBToRGB && layer.apply_mask != 1) ... else (*copy)(layer, i, j, k, l, image, m, n);
note: After the base layer is initialized, higher layers are composited pixel-by-pixel into the final image.

note: For indexed-alpha layers, the merge path reads the alpha tile and uses it to decide whether the source pixel should be opaque or transparent.
